facts.text: The hotel is on the San Antonio River Walk in downtown San Antonio.
facts.excerpt: Perfectly placed on the famous River Walk, The Westin Riverwalk is a premier San Antonio Riverwalk hotel offering extraordinary experiences in the heart of the city.

facts.text: The Alamo is under half a mile away and can be reached on foot.
facts.excerpt: The Alamo situated under a half a mile away and can be easily reached by foot.

facts.text: Rooms have Spanish Colonial decor with rust-red colors, dark wood and iron accents.
facts.excerpt: every room is adorned with Spanish Colonial décor, featuring rust-red colors, dark wood and iron accents.

facts.text: Rooms have views of the River Walk or the cityscape.
facts.excerpt: spacious accommodations with incredible views of the Riverwalk or cityscape

facts.text: Rooms have a Westin Heavenly Bed, a private balcony or terrace and a marble bathroom with a spa-style shower.
facts.excerpt: Feel refreshed after a night’s sleep in a Westin Heavenly® Bed, as the sunlight filters through your private balcony or terrace. Begin the day under your spa-style shower in a marble bathroom

facts.text: Upscale suites offer separate living, work and sleeping areas.
facts.excerpt: Upgrade your stay by reserving an upscale suite, offering separate living, work and sleeping areas.

facts.text: The heated outdoor pool has views of the River Walk and the Tower of the Americas, with a garden-style pool deck.
facts.excerpt: Views of the River Walk and the nearby Tower of the Americas make our pool area a one-of-a-kind sanctuary in the midst of downtown San Antonio. Savor the secluded garden-style feel of our pool deck

facts.text: Zocca Cuisine D'Italia has an indoor-outdoor bar and patio on the River Walk.
facts.excerpt: Zocca Cuisine D'Italia's indoor-outdoor bar and patio

facts.text: A pool bar overlooking the outdoor pool serves handcrafted cocktails and light pub fare on a sunlit patio.
facts.excerpt: stop by our bar's sunlit patio for a handcrafted cocktail and light pub fare.

facts.text: Guests can enjoy live music on select days, river parades and culture-centric events.
facts.excerpt: live music on select days, river parades, and culture-centric events

facts.text: Run Concierges lead guided group runs from the lobby every Tuesday and Thursday at 6am, weather permitting.
facts.excerpt: Our hotel's property Run Concierges lead guided group runs every Tuesday and Thursday at 6am (weather permitting) from our lobby.

facts.text: Kids are greeted at check-in with an amenity bag including a world map and make-your-own postcards.
facts.excerpt: We greet them at check-in with a cool amenity bag with everything they'll need to explore the hotel and beyond.

facts.text: The hotel is dog-friendly for dogs up to 40 pounds, with a Westin Heavenly Dog Bed and pet welcome kit provided.
facts.excerpt: Guests are welcome to bring a canine friend weighing up to 40 pounds. We are happy to provide a Westin Heavenly Dog Bed, pet welcome kit, and food bowls with mat.

facts.text: The lobby has River Walk views.
facts.excerpt: serene lobby with River Walk views

facts.text: The minimum age to check in is 21.
The hotel is about 8.5 miles from San Antonio International Airport.
The hotel is in a quiet section of the River Walk.
facts.excerpt: Stay in our hotel rooms in downtown San Antonio in a picturesque and quiet section of The Riverwalk
